commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Flag goes up against Yaser Asprilla (Girona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+5' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90+4' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+2' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Paulo Gazzaniga no chance!
90+2' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+2' Daley Blind (Girona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Adrian Cordero blows for a foul. Celta Vigo are awarded a penalty kick!
90+1' Michel appears to have said too much and referee Adrian Cordero comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90+1' Bryan Gil (Girona) is booked for saying more than Adrian Cordero was willing to tolerate.
89' The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
83' Lovely run from Bryan Gil (Girona). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Donny van de Beek (Girona) replaces Azzedine Ounahi.
82' Here is a change. Ivan Martin is going off and Michel gives the last tactical orders to Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
81' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
80' Substitution. Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sergio Carreira walks off.
80' Yellow card. Alejandro Frances (Girona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
78' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

78' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Celta Vigo.
72' Girona earn a corner.
70' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) replaces Javier Rodriguez.
70' Substitution. Iago Aspas is replaced by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
70' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bryan Gil (Girona) comes onto the pitch so that Vladyslav Vanat can be given a rest.
67' Michel decides to make a substitution. Arnau Martinez will be replaced by Alejandro Frances (Girona).
66' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) whips the ball into the box and Oscar Mingueza takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.

62' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Paulo Gazzaniga and the score remains the same.
61' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
60' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the left post from inside the box.
60' Substitution. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) on for Ferran Jutgla.
59' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) replacing Pablo Duran.

58' A pass travels right across the box to Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Ionut Radu denies him with a decent save.
57' Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
56' 11:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
53' Adrian Cordero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alex Moreno (Girona).
51' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
51' A cross from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
51' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
50' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
49' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
48' A pass into the box finds Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the top right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Paulo Gazzaniga denies him.
47' The ball is cleared after Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
46' Michel has decided to substitute Joel Roca and he is replaced by Portu (Girona).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Girona comes to nothing.
45+2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Celta Vigo.
45+2' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45+1' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
45' That was close by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
44' Good team movement sets up Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
43' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

42' What a sweet touch by Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and fires a fine shot to the left side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post. The ball goes behind for a corner. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
41' Paulo Gazzaniga pulls off a good save to deny a long-range header from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo). Great goalkeeping!
40' Ivan Martin (Girona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Ionut Radu makes a comfortable save.
37' Joel Roca (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Joel Roca (Girona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
32' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
26' A yellow-coloured card is received by Azzedine Ounahi (Girona).
25' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
21' Joel Roca (Girona) leaps to meet the corner from Yaser Asprilla, but plants his header just over the bar from close range.
21' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
21' Joel Roca (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Girona are awarded a corner kick.
19' Great teamplay by Celta Vigo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
12' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Ivan Martin feeds Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
9' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Oscar Mingueza with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
6' The game is interrupted as Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) is flagged offside.
6' Alex Moreno (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Girona are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
2' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' Referee Adrian Cordero blows his whistle and the match is starting right now.
Girona will kick-off.
